name: Valeriy Lobanovskyi
scopeNote: Counted: Dynamo Kyiv 1973-1982, 1984-1990, 1997-2002 (glavcom.ua; lb.ua says 'from 1974'; exact start days not found, so partial dates are approximate: 1973-01-01 start, 1982/1984/1990 ends are year-level) and the USSR national-team stints tied to Dynamo (1975-76 with Bazilevich, 1982-83, 1986-90 incl. 1986 World Cup, Euro 1988 final, Italia 90). Style is described by sources as pressing/'universality' with scientific planning (Zelentsov), with man-orientations plus zonal cover, not Total Football (he rejected the label). Excluded: Dnipro 1969-73 (no titles, formative), UAE 1990-92 and Kuwait 1994-96 (no tactical coverage, lesser job), Ukraine 2000-02 (part-time alongside Dynamo, playoff only). Facts from the end of the Dynamo period (2000-02) are thin. Dynamo end date is the death of 2002-05-13 (taken ill 2002-05-07).
openQuestions: Exact appointment/departure dates for each Dynamo and USSR spell not found (lb.ua says Dynamo from 1974, glavcom 1973); confirm from a dated source.
Dynamo's 1997-98 marking was described as zonal cover with man-orientations; whether 1970s/80s sides were stricter man-oriented is only from retrospectives (Baltacha, Lovchev).
Primary dated sources for Lobanovskyi's own quotes (Methodological Basis book, Endless Match) not found; all quotes attributed.
Credit for pressing origins is contested: Maslov (1960s Dynamo) vs Lobanovskyi.
